sub_items.description: Notice of Claim – Kirk Family v. State of Utah, UVU Police Department, Chief Jeffrey Long, Astrid Tuminez, and Presently Unknown Others
Associated Press article – "Utah Valley University is launching an independent external review of the fatal shooting of prominent conservative activist Charlie Kirk on its campus earlier this month."

artifacts.bundle_name: Brian Harpole / Shawn Ryan Interview Clip Bundle

sub_items.description: Clip – Brian Harpole reading security team credentials on the Shawn Ryan show (Blake, combat-proven Marine; SEALs; world-renowned jiu-jitsu people; 22 years SWAT; 30-year cop and SWAT commander; 20-year Marine; professional athletes with tactical careers)

artifacts.bundle_name: Dan Flood / Chief Jeffrey Long Text Message Bundle

sub_items.description: Text message exchange between Dan Flood and UVU Chief Jeffrey Long regarding Sorenson Student Center roof access
Still image showing Sorenson Center staircase leading to walkway above Charlie Kirk's seating position
Bodycam footage dated May 31, 2022 – Tyler Robinson traffic-stop interaction, St. George Police Department
Scripps News headline – "Scriptscripts News obtains video of accused Charlie Kirk shooter after the 2022 car crash"

artifacts.bundle_name: NY Post / Sky News Tyler Robinson Hat & Sunglasses Bundle

sub_items.description: Sky News / NY Post article – Tyler Robinson described as wearing "an eerily similar hat and sunglasses" as in the 2022 footage

artifacts.bundle_name: Jim Spencer / Scripps News Bio Bundle

sub_items.description: Bio information – Jim Spencer, founder of Scripps News (formerly Newsy, founded 2022), teaches digital media and journalism at UT Austin since 2018
Information regarding Nell DeBuckman's 2022 donation of a 2,300 sq ft building – Buckman Center – to UT Austin for mixed media and artists

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the notice of claim and central figure of the series.

nodes.name: Notice of Claim Timing Anomaly
nodes.description: Persistent target: the wrongful-death notice of claim was filed approximately one year after the incident and two days before the expected release of UVU's independent review of security failures. Investigating whether the filing is preemptive.

nodes.name: Tyler Robinson 2022 Bodycam Footage Provenance Question
nodes.description: Persistent target: investigating who retained the May 31, 2022 bodycam footage for approximately three years, why it was retained past Utah's 60–90 day routine-footage retention period, and how Scripps News obtained and released it within seven days of Tyler Robinson's identification as suspect.

nodes.name: Notice of Claim Text Message Omission
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim's quotation of the Dan Flood / Chief Long text exchange omits the line "I was told students have access above us," which materially changes the contextual reading from a general "rooftops" concern to a targeted walkway-above-Charlie concern.

nodes.name: UVU Officer Allocation Ratio for Charlie Kirk Event
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim alleges UVU assigned six of 24 total officers to the outdoor event with approximately 3,000 attendees; host calculates this is mathematically an oversupply relative to UVU's 50,000-student base.

nodes.name: Utah Bodycam Routine Footage Retention Law
nodes.description: Persistent target: investigating whether the May 31, 2022 Tyler Robinson footage should have been purged under Utah's 60–90 day retention schedule for routine, non-criminal interactions.

nodes.name: UVU EMS Presence at Scene Verification
nodes.description: Persistent target: the notice of claim alleges no first responders were available; host asserts UVU's state-certified emergency medical services were on scene at the vehicle with medical bags.

nodes.name: Independent Review of UVU Security Failures
nodes.description: Persistent target: UVU-commissioned third-party review announced September 22, 2025; findings expected imminently (host reports "Friday").

nodes.name: Candace Owens
nodes.description: Host of the Candace Kirk Archive series and primary investigator of claims presented in this episode.

nodes.name: Maycee Crofts
nodes.description: TPUSA senior field representative. The UVU independent review names her as directing the courtyard and fountain booking.

nodes.name: Tyler Robinson
nodes.description: Prelim-hearing week timing for DoD/thread and paid anti-Candace surge; Discord confession framing recalled.

nodes.name: Shawn Ryan
nodes.description: Podcast host of the Brian Harpole interview that the independent review and this episode treat as contradictory to review-team findings.

nodes.name: Brian Harpole
nodes.description: Comments: hospital supposedly did not know they were coming vs redirect audio to Timpanogos.

nodes.name: Dan Flood
nodes.description: Security teammate; Turek says Flood showed the "I got you covered" roofs text (timing corrected mid-story).

nodes.name: Jeff Long
nodes.description: UVU police chief; Turek recounts Long saying he was thrown under the bus and arguing only the bridge roof was covered.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Filed Against Utah, UVU PD, Chief Long, Tuminez, and Unknown Others
claims.claim: The Kirk family filed a notice of claim against the State of Utah, the UVU Police Department, UVU Police Chief Jeffrey Long, former UVU president Astrid Tuminez, and others presently "unknown" involved in Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed notice of claim from the Utah Attorney General's office and confirm the precise list of named respondents.

claims.label: UVU Launched Independent External Review September 22, 2025
claims.claim: Approximately twelve days after Charlie Kirk's death, UVU announced an independent external review of the security failures.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference UVU board minutes and the AP wire story against UVU press releases from September 22, 2025.

claims.label: Tuminez Quoted on Review Purpose
claims.claim: Astrid Tuminez stated UVU "will integrate the findings into our efforts to strengthen and improve safety practices for UVU and all of Utah higher education."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Tuminez's original emailed statement to confirm exact wording.

claims.label: Security Team Credentials Presented by Harpole on Shawn Ryan Show
claims.claim: Brian Harpole presented on the Shawn Ryan show that the security team included combat-proven Marines, SEALs, 22-year SWAT veterans, 30-year cop and SWAT commander, and world-renowned jiu-jitsu practitioners.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve full unedited Shawn Ryan episode and verify Harpole's on-air list against TPUSA security contractor records.

claims.label: Charlie's Security Team Comprised 12 Members
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk had a total of 12 security members at the UVU event.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against TPUSA's security manifest and the eventual independent review findings.

claims.label: Text Message Identified Sorenson Staircase Roof Access
claims.claim: The displayed text message exchange between Dan Flood and Chief Jeffrey Long specifically referenced the Sorenson Student Center staircases providing access to walkways on the roof above where CK would be set up.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original text thread metadata (timestamps, sender numbers) and confirm the recipient list.

claims.label: Chief Long Responded "I got you covered"
claims.claim: Chief Jeffrey Long responded to Dan Flood's rooftop-access request with the message "I got you covered."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU PD records and text-message metadata.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Omits "I was told students have access above us" Line
claims.claim: The notice of claim's quotation of the Dan Flood / Chief Long text exchange omits the original line "I was told students have access above us," which materially narrows the rooftop reference to the specific walkway above Charlie's head.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed notice of claim text and the underlying original text records to formally document the omission and contextual difference.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Six Officers Assigned to Outdoor Event
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU assigned only six campus police officers to the outdoor tour event that ultimately attracted approximately 3,000 attendees.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference UVU PD staffing logs from September 10, 2025.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Cites Approximately 3,000 Attendees
claims.claim: The notice of claim states the UVU event attracted approximately 3,000 attendees.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against UVU venue capacity records, ticketing data, and aerial footage crowd estimates.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Long Requested Additional Officers
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges that UVU Chief Jeff Long requested approval from then-UVU president Astrid Tuminez to allocate more than six officers.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain UVU PD internal communications and presidential approval logs from September 2025.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges Request for Additional Officers Denied
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges that the request for additional officers was denied.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Tuminez's contemporaneous internal communications and PD shift logs.

claims.label: Bodycam Footage Released Seven Days After Suspect Identification
claims.claim: The 2022 bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson was released seven days after the public identified Tyler Robinson as the suspect.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Scripps News publication date and Tyler Robinson's public identification date.

claims.label: Bodycam Footage Dated May 31, 2022
claims.claim: The bodycam footage of Tyler Robinson is dated May 31, 2022 – approximately three and a half years prior to release.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the timestamp metadata on the released footage.

claims.label: Bodycam Footage Released by Scripps News
claims.claim: The 2022 bodycam footage was released by Scripps News under the headline "[Scripps] News obtains video of accused Charlie Kirk shooter after the 2022 car crash." **Name uncertainty:** transcript also spells as "Scriptscripts News" and "Scripts Media."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve Scripps News editorial sourcing notes and FOIAA / records-request logs.

claims.label: Scripps News Founded 2022; Founder Jim Spencer
claims.claim: Scripps News became operational the same year as the 2022 incident and was founded by Jim Spencer, who was formerly with Newsy.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm corporate registration records for Scripps News and Newsy's corporate history.

claims.label: Jim Spencer Teaches Digital Media at UT Austin Since 2018
claims.claim: Jim Spencer teaches digital media and journalism at UT Austin, having done so since 2018.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Spencer's UT Austin faculty page and Nell DeBuckman / Buckman Center affiliation.

claims.label: Bodycam Footage Recorded by St. George Police Department
claims.claim: The May 31, 2022 bodycam footage was recorded by an officer in the St. George Police Department.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm agency identification via officer's uniform markings and incident report cross-reference.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson Was 19 at Time of 2022 Incident
claims.claim: Tyler Robinson was 19 years old at the time of the 2022 traffic incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against birth records / official DOB.

claims.label: UVU Has Approximately 50,000 Students
claims.claim: UVU has a total of 50,000 students.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU's official enrollment figures.

claims.label: UVU Has 24 Police Officers
claims.claim: UVU has 24 police officers available to cover its campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against UVU PD staffing rosters and Utah public-safety salary records.

claims.label: Event Scheduled at Amphitheater After Maycee Crofts Demand on August 25, 2025
claims.claim: On August 25, 2025, TPUSA events committee employee Maycee Crofts insisted during a Microsoft Teams call that the event be held in the amphitheater; UVU acquiesced. **Timestamp uncertainty:** transcript spells year as "20125" – clearly a transcription error for 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Recover Microsoft Teams call metadata and any TPUSA event-planning emails.

claims.label: UVU EMS Was on Scene with First Responders
claims.claim: UVU's state-certified emergency medical services were present beside the vehicle with medical bags.
claims.investigative_direction: Review UVU EMS bodycam footage and any contemporaneous dispatch logs.

claims.label: UVU Independent Review Findings Expected Imminently
claims.claim: The findings of UVU's independent external review of security failures were due to be released on Friday (immediately following the episode air date).
claims.investigative_direction: Monitor UVU press releases and the Utah Attorney General's office.

claims.label: Charlie's Security Arrived at 9:00 AM Morning of Event
claims.claim: Members of Charlie's security team arrived on the UVU campus at 9:00 AM on the morning of September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against UVU PD visitor logs and hotel / travel records of the security detail.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges UVU Failed to Maintain Secure Perimeter
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU parties could have created and maintained a secure perimeter with controlled ingress/egress points and security screenings.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare allegation text against UVU's pre-event security plan submission (if any).

claims.label: Notice of Claim Alleges UVU Could Have Restricted Attendee Numbers
claims.claim: The notice of claim alleges UVU parties had the power and authority to impose attendee-number restrictions.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify ticket-sales authority and UVU event-permit conditions.

claims.label: Notice of Claim Concludes with State-Created Danger and Wrongful Death Claims
claims.claim: The notice of claim concludes that "the UVU party's omissions, actions and misconduct led to Mr. Kirk's death" and asserts both a state-created danger claim under the U.S. Constitution's due process clause and a traditional wrongful death claim under Utah law.
claims.investigative_direction: Track subsequent civil complaint filings with the Utah Attorney General's office.
